item: The corpus-integrity scan resumes where a timed-out run stopped and Thorough states its cost first
summary: The three exact integrity checks run in id ranges with a saved cursor, so a 60 s budget no longer leaves them forever incomplete; the verdict names the checks that finished. Thorough shows an expected pause derived from this machine's own scan walls per row (field medians for the rest), with the count timed, before collection is paused.
